item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates both `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"chat\")` and `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"text\")`, then calls `forward(prompt=\"ping\")` on each."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.completion` and `litellm.text_completion`, records both call sites, and asserts exactly one call to each."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the chat request preserved `messages == [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"ping\"}]`, confirming the chat path kept the message list."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts text-mode rewrite to `prompt == \"ping\\n\\nBEGIN RESPONSE:\"`, rewritten model `text-completion-openai/my-text-model`, and passthrough `api_base`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
